summary: CMS Consolidation & Multilingual Governance Sprint — frontend-only testing of 10 acceptance criteria. 9/10 pass. One issue: /partner-application hero section renders as black/empty box — CMS content (CANDIDATURA PARTNER eyebrow, hero title) not visible even though page is accessible and form loads below.

ui_bugs.issue: Hero section renders as a black/dark empty rectangle — 'CANDIDATURA PARTNER' eyebrow and hero title text are not visible. The form content below it loads fine. Likely useStorefrontContent('partner-application') CMS fetch returns data but hero_editorial section content is not being rendered (background image missing, text invisible on dark bg, or CMS section data not mapping correctly).

action_items: Fix /partner-application hero: hero_editorial section content not rendering — black box visible instead of CMS hero with 'CANDIDATURA PARTNER' eyebrow. Check useStorefrontContent hook response and hero component rendering logic in PartnerApplicationPage.jsx
critical_code_review_comments: PartnerApplicationPage.jsx: hero uses useStorefrontContent(TENANT_SLUG, 'partner-application') — but hero renders as black box. Either the CMS hero_editorial section data structure doesn't match what the component expects, or the background image URL is missing/broken.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CMS sprint largely working: /professionals shows 6 ProTriptych types (CMS-driven), 3 case studies (Villa privata Brianza, Resort Costiera Amalfitana, Penthouse Milano) from PartnerCasesSection, no hardcoded PartnerTypesGrid. Header nav labels all CMS-driven (COME LAVORIAMO, MAGAZINE, PROGETTI, PER I PROFESSIONISTI) + CTAs visible. Homepage/About/Services all load with CMS content. Only remaining issue: /partner-application hero renders as black box — CMS hero_editorial content not displayed.
rca_of_issue: /partner-application hero black box: The hero section relies on useStorefrontContent to fetch hero_editorial section. Either (1) the background image URL stored in CMS is broken/missing causing dark overlay with no visible background, or (2) the text content exists in CMS but white text is rendered on a black/no-image background making it invisible. Check PartnerApplicationPage.jsx hero rendering and verify CMS hero_editorial section has a valid image_url field.
